hypotheses: Keep whole-string NFKD and case-fold ordering unchanged; remove category Mn through a mapping of unique decomposed characters instead of repeated per-character category checks.
Reuse deterministic single-character folds only inside the already existing excerpt source-map fallback; preserve its historical per-character transform and every output source coordinate.
Compute identical directory index text once per changed ingest rather than once per page; keep index schema, SQL insertion order and all indexed values unchanged.
preserve: all complete recall fields except latency_ms
exact compact MCP tool response bytes and envelope fields
query terms, ranking, candidate limits, citations, character caps and source coordinates
existing source normalization order, Unicode category Mn policy and combining-class distinctions
existing token_budget.py, semantic.py, MCP server and historical reports

measurement.engine_order: baseline,candidate in even rounds; candidate,baseline in odd rounds
measurement.query_order: random.Random(61 + 1009 * round + budget_chars), same for paired engines
measurement.mcp_cache: One official-SDK stdio server; DELETE recall_cache and commit before every timed call through an external SQLite connection. No result reuse; normal server cache-write cost remains included.
measurement.scope: Independent hosted VM; sequential isolated engine workers; no concurrent benchmark processes. Warm OS/SQLite caches, not an OS-cold-cache claim.
record: all per-query payload hashes and elapsed samples
p50/p95/mean for every configuration and every round
actual compact MCP bytes and both reference-tokenizer counts
fresh ingestion and unchanged reingestion costs
process RSS/high-water RSS and native MCP child high-water RSS
logical DB and live DB/WAL/SHM bytes

validation.gate: All complete payloads match across engines and rounds; corpus/query counts, exact source stability, candidate source diff scope and identical indexed content pass. Failed or missing rows invalidate completion.
tests: cached fallback folds and every source offset match the historical per-character algorithm
ASCII, CJK, accents, case-fold expansions and deterministic Unicode fuzz
directory index reuse preserves both indexes and metadata updates

durability: Checkpoint every completed worker and publish new run-specific reports, never overwrite historical reports. Retain all rounds and regressions; do not select the fastest round.
limits: Old synthetic/public regression data only. Do not read new blinded Hotpot256 or run model/answer experiments. No promise of universal latency, memory, indexing or product superiority follows from these measurements.
